name: fantasy-hub
status_detail: Multi-league fantasy football tools. Every tool lives under /l/[leagueId] with leagues auto-discovered from Sleeper and format detected from settings.type (including type 3, which is Sleeper's undocumented guillotine code). Four live leagues: Dah Dynasty League (dynasty, in season), 2026 Half PPR (redraft, drafts Sep 7), Sunday Scaries #2 (redraft, full PPR, in season), and Dah Chopped League (guillotine, 16 teams, $1000 FAAB, still pre-draft). Guillotine leagues get a weekly FAAB advisor at /l/[id]/faab, /api/faab and a Tuesday email. Written playbooks with sources at /strategy.
next_steps: CONFIRM WITH THE COMMISSIONER: does the chopped roster go to waivers or straight to free agency, and which day do waivers process? Sleeper says waiver_day_of_week 2 with a 1-day clear, but that code is ambiguous. The Tuesday email assumes Tuesday morning.

Set RESEND_API_KEY, FAAB_EMAIL_TO=jackhastings00@gmail.com and FAAB_EMAIL_FROM on a hastingsdigital.co sender, locally and in Vercel Production. Preview any time with /api/faab-email?dry=1 and send on demand with ?force=1.

AFTER THE FIRST CHOP, verify chop detection end to end. It works by diffing this week's rosters against last week's snapshot in Upstash, so week 1 stores the baseline and week 2 is the first week that can attribute players to a chopped roster. Never verified against a real chop.

SCORING SKEW IS READ BUT STILL NOT USED OUTSIDE GUILLOTINE. passTd is on the profile (4 in Chopped and Half PPR, 6 in Sunday Scaries and Dynasty) and only the guillotine advisor consumes scoring properly, via lib/guillotine/scoring.ts which scores raw Sleeper stat lines under the league's own settings. The draft board and rankings still assume one scoring shape. That scoring module is reusable and is the fix.
2026 Half PPR draft is Mon Sep 7 6:00 PM. Slot 11 of 12, pick projections and tier cliffs are wired in

TWO PACING MODELS NOW EXIST. lib/strategy/guillotine.ts still gates season goals on calendar month; lib/guillotine/budget.ts paces on eliminations remaining, which is correct for a 16-team league that reaches the endgame around week 11. Point the season-goals rules at budget.ts so they cannot disagree.
Re-pull the Lab 300 when Jingles posts a new version (v2.0 is current; docs/refreshing-jingles.md)
Wire 2026 NFL schedule into survivor future-scarcity grid
Integrate Vegas lines via the-odds-api before Week 1
blockers: Dah Chopped has NOT DRAFTED and the season starts Sep 9. 16 teams, 14-round snake, no start time set. Everything in the FAAB advisor is gated behind the draft, so it reports a clean pre_draft refusal until the league drafts. Chase the commissioner for a draft date.

RESEND_API_KEY, FAAB_EMAIL_TO and FAAB_EMAIL_FROM are not set in this project, so the Tuesday cron builds the report and skips the send. Jack has a Resend account and hastingsdigital.co is verified there; paste the values into .env.local and Vercel Production to turn the email on.

The chop mechanic is assumed, not confirmed: the advisor assumes the commissioner force-drops the chopped roster to WAIVERS. Sleeper does not liquidate it automatically. If the commissioner drops to open free agency instead, bidding advice matters far less than speed and the design would need revisiting.

notes.note: GUILLOTINE WEEKLY FAAB ADVISOR SHIPPED. Jack asked for a weekly guide telling him where to put FAAB in Dah Chopped, in the app and by email. Researched the format first (docs/guillotine-strategy.md carries the numbers and sources: Fantasy Life, RotoWire, DraftSharks, Footballguys, Fantasy Alarm, guillotineleagues.com, r/GuillotineLeagues), then read the league instead of trusting the published standard, which changed the design four times. It is 16 teams not the 18 every guide assumes, FULL PPR against a half-PPR Lab 300, 4-point pass TDs, no K or DST slots, and TRADES ARE DISABLED, so FAAB is literally the only way to acquire anyone. Also learned Sleeper now supports guillotine natively as settings.type 3, undocumented in their API reference and contradicted by their own help article; the app had been reaching the right answer by regex-matching the axe emoji in the league name. FOUR IDEAS DO THE WORK. (1) Elimination risk is a probability, not a rank: 20k Monte Carlo draws over every alive team's projected score, so the answer is 'you carry 12.5% against a 6.25% baseline' rather than 'you are 12th'. (2) A player is worth what he adds to your STARTING lineup, so the solver refuses to sell you a 9.4 tight end when your flex already starts a 9.4. (3) Pacing runs on eliminations remaining, not the calendar, because the published month-by-month curve was written for an 18-team league running to December and this one reaches the endgame around week 11. (4) Claims are grouped into chains that all drop the SAME player, making them mutually exclusive, because four independent claims that each look reasonable can all land and cost four times what you meant to spend. VERIFIED AGAINST REAL DATA by temporarily pointing the report at Sunday Scaries (Dah Chopped has not drafted), which caught four genuine bugs no unit test would have: the hold curve said hold 100% before the first chop, making week one unbiddable; the top-32 'championship' bar was computed league-wide, so quarterbacks (who outscore everyone) filled it and every spare QB read as worth 20% of budget, now a per-position bar; the candidate pool was a flat top-120 by projection, which in a one-QB league is nothing but backup QBs, now top-30 per position; and the posture text called 1.5x average risk 'about average' while Jack was the single likeliest team to be chopped. Also reframed the chop line visual after seeing it: a single line at the average low score put every team comfortably clear and read as safety, so the page now draws the BAND the line lands in (64 to 97 in the test week) plus each team's floor, which is what actually makes 12.5% risk legible next to a 112-point projection. 119 unit tests, vitest added to the project. One report object feeds the page, the API and the email so they cannot drift, which is the lesson from the draft board existing twice.

LIVE DRAFT BOARD IS NOW AN API (/api/draft?league=<id>), registered as Atlas source 2. The feature already existed on the draft page: live picks, what Jack has taken, which starting slots are open, pool ranked on the Lab 300. It just could not leave the screen, so during a draft the answer to "who do I take" was on a laptop he was not looking at, and he drafts on his phone. So this was extraction, not invention: lib/redraft/live-board.ts holds the assembly and both the page and the API call it, because two implementations of best available that drift is worse than not having the second one. Response leads with draft.started (a board for a draft that has not begun is a cheat sheet, not advice on the clock) and stillNeed in plain words. Dynasty is refused by name rather than answered. Verified live on all three leagues: redraft 287 pool, guillotine 273, dynasty refused. ALSO TODAY: Lab 300 v2.0, rank chip on every player via PlayerLink (gated by a new LeagueTypeProvider so dynasty shows nothing), and player=Name lookup on /api/jingles after Atlas could not answer "pollard or jacobs" because the API could only page from the top.

LAB 300 v2.0 (8/30) replaces v1.0 (8/16). Parsed from the PDF, not typed: 300 ranks complete, no duplicates, every player on a Sleeper id (295 kept, 5 looked up). 279 of 300 changed rank, 5 in, 5 out; Tee Higgins is off the list entirely. Final 50 tier is gone, so 14 tiers not 15. Two errors in his PDF corrected and only those two: Rhamondre Stevenson on "NET" read as NE, and the Bears defence listed on DET read as CHI. The second one mattered because Sleeper keys a defence by its team, so verbatim would have given the Bears DST Detroit's id. FORMAT SCOPE now explicit: Jack said twice that this is redraft and guillotine only, never dynasty. It had lived as a bare inequality inside one badge component and the API said nothing, which meant Atlas (which reads that API and cannot see the league) would naturally quote a redraft rank at a dynasty trade. Now one constant in the data module, read by the badge, and appliesTo plus a scope note on the API response.

notes: 2026-08-30: Pushed the three stuck commits so the live site stops reading Dah Chopped as dynasty. Investigated adding a Yahoo league and parked it: Yahoo gates the Fantasy API behind an approval queue, so the app authenticates fine but the endpoint answers additional_authorization_required. Findings kept in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-30-yahoo-league-source-design.md.

2026-08-25: Sunday Scaries #2 joined (12-team, full PPR, single QB, no DEF or K slot, drafts Aug 27). Discovery is automatic but the league list is cached for 6 hours and /api/refresh never busted it, so a new league was invisible until the TTL lapsed; refresh now drops the list, takes the leagueId of the page you are on instead of always refreshing the dynasty league, and busts FantasyCalc values and the drafts list (which carries draft_order) rather than only RosterAudit. Draft board now filters the pool to positions the league actually starts: 15 kickers dropped everywhere, 15 defenses dropped in leagues with no DEF slot. Board carries a note when league scoring is not half PPR, since the Lab 300 is. Snapshot cron and the league dashboard no longer ask RosterAudit for redraft grades (it answers 400): the cron is now a clean single-league run. Season plan was dynasty-shaped for every format: hardcoded 'superflex with TE premium' header, 'Rookie draft window' phase, a permanent em dash Dynasty rank tile, and made-up ranks off empty pre-draft rosters. All four now follow the format.

2026-08-24: Auto-deploy fixed. The Aug 17 diagnosis (missing GitHub webhooks) was wrong: GitHub App integrations do not create per-repo webhooks, so an empty /hooks list proved nothing. The real fault was that the Vercel project had no Git repository connected at all, which vercel git disconnect reported plainly. One vercel git connect restored it; a test push built and deployed in 22s with no manual step. CRON_SECRET is also set in Production, and /api/snapshot now returns 401 without the bearer token.

2026-08-24: Tier cliff added to the redraft board. Each pick card names who is projected to go before you are back on the clock, plus a chip when his Lab 300 tier cannot last the wait (players left in tier vs picks until your next). First version compared this pick tier to next pick tier and fired on every card, since his tiers run about a round wide.

2026-08-24: Two things shipped. (1) Rank history: roster grades are now logged to Upstash once a day (cron at /api/snapshot plus an opportunistic write on dashboard render), and the dynasty tile shows a chip like "down 4 since Aug 14" with the names who moved past you. Built after a #6 to #10 slide could not be explained, since RosterAudit publishes a live grade and no history. (2) Redraft draft board reads the Sleeper draft order: Pick 11 of 12 chip in the header, plus a Your picks section projecting who is on the board at each of the next six picks if the room drafts straight down the Lab 300. (3) Diagnosis of the slide itself: no code or roster cause, team value flat since May, the model reweighted trajectory. Superflex QB room is the real problem: Dart 4,453 plus Geno 217 against a league range of 7.8k to 17.3k, traced to the May 8 Hurts trade.

2026-08-17: The Lab 300 shipped (his tiered top-300 half-PPR ranking, v1.0, a Google Drive PDF). All 300 parsed and resolved to Sleeper ids; redraft draft board is now ordered by it, with FantasyCalc value alongside. Fills the DEF gap since he ranks 14 defenses and 15 kickers. Also fixed a recommendation miscalibration (need bonus was worth 32 picks, not the documented ~12) and a display bug mixing his overall rank with FantasyCalc's position rank.

2026-08-15: Redraft draft board shipped. The draft page had been running rookie logic for every format, recommending a rookie at #1 with 'max dynasty runway' in the redraft league. Non-dynasty leagues now rank the whole pool on FantasyCalc redraft value with starting-slot awareness, plus a Jingles-vs-ADP section. DEF marked 'not valued' since FantasyCalc has no defenses. Redraft draft scheduled for Mon Sep 7 6:00 PM.

2026-08-15: Split rankings and resources by format. Player pages had contradicted themselves, showing RosterAudit dynasty tiers and a KeepTradeCut cross-check under a 'Redraft values' label; those are now dynasty-only and the headline value/rank/trend follow the format's source. Resources tagged and filterable (51 dynasty, 39 redraft, 26 guillotine), with 30 researched redraft entries, all URLs verified. Corrected how Jingles Labs is described: he posts high/low-vs-ADP calls and league-winner deep dives, not rankings. Added his James Cook deep dive and a 'pulled <date>' staleness marker.

2026-08-14: Phase 2 shipped. season-plan split into src/lib/strategy with per-format rule sets; playoff berths and season length now read from league settings. New /strategy page carries researched playbooks for all three formats with 12 external sources. Guillotine numbers sourced from Fantasy Life, RotoWire, DraftSharks, Fantasy Index, Footballguys. Verified guillotine rules via a temporary route across September-danger and December-endgame states, which caught three contradictions in the endgame goals.

2026-08-14: Phase 1 multi-league shipped. Routes moved from /dynasty to /l/[leagueId] with permanent redirects, league switcher in the header, nav renders only format-appropriate tools. Values now format-aware: 87 of 200 shared players move 20+ ranks between dynasty and redraft. Jingles Labs added (21 calls, 30 tiered backup RBs). Design spec at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-14-multi-league-design.md.
2026-08-14: Renamed Dynasty Hub to Fantasy Hub across code, GitHub repo, Vercel project, and local folder. Live at fantasy-hub-tan.vercel.app; dynasty-hub-nine.vercel.app still resolves.
2026-05-17: Dashboard registration. Last work was survivor Phase 1 (pool config, team matrix, baseline ratings, strategy library) committed 2026-05-10.

2026-08-28: 'Dah Chopped League' was being read as DYNASTY for weeks. Sleeper returns type code 3, which is not in the map, and the fallback was dynasty on the reasoning that it hides fewer tools. That was backwards: dynasty tools in a league with no dynasty are tools that are WRONG. Unknown codes read as redraft now and typeConfident marks the guess. It is also a real guillotine league, which the app assumed could not exist on Sleeper; the name check only matched 'guillotine' and his is 'Dah Chopped League 🪓', so it matches chopped and the axe now. Three settings the app never read are on the profile: passTd, faab and tradeDeadlineWeek, plus non-zero bonuses. Verified against all four live leagues. Committed 2e9e09b, NOT PUSHED.
